about: Hand-labelled synthetic answers for spot-checking the two heuristic detectors in run_eval.py. Written and labelled offline (no model calls) by the assistant on 2026-11-05; the human_confirmed column is for Kishore's review. Gold labels were written from the case evidence and embedded-systems facts BEFORE running the detectors. 'untraceable' = the specific claim cannot be traced to the evidence given to the model or to the reference answer. 'wrong' = the claim is factually incorrect.

unsupported_claims.prose: GPIO34 is input-only (pins 34-39 have no output driver). Move the LED to GPIO2.
unsupported_claims.note: all tokens in evidence or reference

unsupported_claims.prose: GPIO34 is input-only; use GPIO 35 instead.
unsupported_claims.note: GPIO35 is also input-only; written with a space

unsupported_claims.prose: GPIO34 is input-only; switch to GPIO_NUM_13 and keep GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT.
unsupported_claims.note: GPIO13 is output-capable but not named in evidence/reference

unsupported_claims.prose: GPIO34 is input-only on the ESP32; GPIO34 to GPIO39 lack output drivers.
unsupported_claims.note: true, but no datasheet was given in no_rag

unsupported_claims.prose: The GPIOA clock is never enabled; call __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE(), which sets GPIOAEN in RCC_AHB1ENR.
unsupported_claims.note: register name correct but not in the excerpt

unsupported_claims.prose: Enable it with RCC->AHB1ENR |= RCC_AHB1ENR_GPIOAEN; (register at 0x40023830).
Call __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE(); the clock bit lives in RCC_APB2ENR at 0x40023844.
unsupported_claims.note: GPIOA is on AHB1 on STM32F4

unsupported_claims.prose: With AD0 high the device answers at 0x69, but the code uses 0x68.
Use address 0x69. Reading WHO_AM_I (0x75) should then return 0x68.
unsupported_claims.note: claim 'WHO_AM_I returns 0x68' is not in the evidence; the token 0x68 appears in the code for another reason

unsupported_claims.prose: With AD0 high the address is 0xD0.
on_rx is NULL, so the call branches to 0x00000000 with the T bit clear: INVSTATE, escalated to a FORCED HardFault.
INVSTATE is set; LR 0x08000a3b is the caller and the faulting address is in MMFAR = 0xE000ED34.
unsupported_claims.note: that is MMFAR's own address and MMFAR is not valid here

unsupported_claims.prose: Enable UsageFault with SCB->SHCSR |= SCB_SHCSR_USGFAULTENA_Msk to get a dedicated fault handler.
lastBlink is a 16-bit int (max 32,767) and goes negative after 32.767 s. Use unsigned long.
millis() itself overflows after 49.7 days (0xFFFFFFFF ms); use uint32_t.
HAL_UART_MODULE_ENABLED is commented out; uncomment it in stm32f4xx_hal_conf.h.
Also define USE_HAL_DRIVER and add HAL_UART_MspInit for USART2 on PA2/PA3 (AF7).
Wi-Fi TX current peaks trip the detector; its level is set by CONFIG_ESP_BROWNOUT_DET_LVL_SEL_0.
GPIO34 can drive the LED once CONFIG_GPIO34_OUTPUT_ENABLE is set in menuconfig.
The LED on PA5 needs GPIO_PULLUP to light.
unsupported_claims.note: push-pull output does not need a pull-up
